limitations: Exploratory source-alert scenarios; wallet/tier identity unverified. Not frozen Genius research.

One $1000 shared account with separate Fresh and Add-alert scalp sections. $200 target notional, tracked fresh-position adds up to $350. Source leverage matched only when readable and within venue limits; collateral/liquidation unverified.20 total slots; cash and risk gates apply.
4.5bps/side assumed fees, 10bps/side adverse slippage; funding excluded.
Stops sampled at observed books; gaps can exceed risk. No invented fills or historical entries.
GitHub scheduled jobs can be late or skipped; not guaranteed nonstop. Telegram not connected.

freshAddressProbeFinding: Payload account for7291 returned no fills in05:29–05:33Z and no current perpetual positions. Agent/subaccount mapping remains unresolved; empty lookup is not proof of nonexistent trading.
inferenceLimits: Every closed settlement has an oracle inferred from2 public cashflows under1microUSDC rounding. This is not measured copier funding or mark/liquidation replay. Open funding remains missing; canonical ledger unchanged.
sourceCaptureBlock: Direct runtime website request returned403 and was not retried. One hosted bounded checker succeeded; its readable excerpt corroborated payload LONG and0x00c9…2bd2 for7286, but attribution to a venue account remains unresolved.
